# vlmkit

> Verify frontend changes with @mizchi/vlmkit: compare rendered HTML or screenshots, manage visual baselines, and inspect layout, accessibility or interaction defects. Use after visible UI changes or for a requested visual audit. Choose deterministic checks first, then use model-assisted modes when the task requires them.
